kb_arrival.title: Signing In at the Gate
kb_arrival.description: Go up to the Long Shelf, the second gallery of Kael's Bastion, then come back to Gate-Warden Vessaria.
kb_arrival.accept_text:
Everyone who comes through this gate gets written into the Codex, and I've written you in. When you leave I'll ask what you're taking out with you, so keep track of anything you pick up in the cavern.

Go up the main walkway to the Long Shelf. It's the second gallery, the wide one with the open square in the middle. The inn and the traders are up there, and people will want to meet you. Come back and tell me when you've had a look round.
kb_arrival.turn_in_text:
Good, you found it. You're the four hundred and tenth person through this gate since we came down three years ago.

People here will be polite to you, but some of them won't know what to make of you yet. You arrived on this world the same year we arrived in this cavern, and a few of them find that strange. Give them time. Thanks for coming back.

kb_index_failing.title: Things That Don't Fit
kb_index_failing.description: Bring Archivist Nessaly Worked Dalaran Fragments from the Archive Revenants and Lattice Cores from the Lattice.
kb_index_failing.accept_text:
Every find in this cavern gets a number and a heading in the Codex. Forty-one of them don't fit under any heading we have, and that number keeps going up.

Two of them are bothering me most. The revenants in the Weeping Colonnade carry pieces of worked Dalaran stone, and nobody ever brought Dalaran stone down here. The sentries and diviners in the Lattice carry crystal cores that look cut, not grown. I want a few of each on my bench so I can compare them.

The Colonnade is south of the gate. The Lattice is north-east.
kb_index_failing.turn_in_text:
Look at the edges on these. The fragments and the cores were both cut, and whatever cut them did it in one pass without any mistakes. I think they were made the same way.

That means I'll need a new heading in the Codex, and I don't know what to call it yet. Thank you. This will keep me busy for a while.

kb_pages.title: Out of Paper
kb_pages.description: Press sets of Frostpine Pages for Archivist Nessaly. Frostpine grows up on the surface, the nearest in Eastern Hillsbrad.
kb_pages.accept_text:
We're running out of paper. Everything we write on had to be carried down here, and there are no trees in this cavern. The fungus won't press into anything you can write on, I've tried.

Frostpine makes good pages. It grows up on the surface, and the nearest place is Eastern Hillsbrad, back up the way you came in. Cut the wood, plane it, and press as many sets of pages as I need. Press them somewhere warm. Pages pressed in the cold crack, and we lost four months of field notes that way.
kb_pages.turn_in_text:
That's about three weeks of work for the Archive, so these help a lot. I've been asking people to write smaller.

Thank you for going all the way up for these.

kb_reagents.title: Better Than They Should Be
kb_reagents.description: Brew Elixirs of Arcane Fury for Alchemist Terrowen, using herbs you gather in the Underdark.
kb_reagents.accept_text:
For three years every herb I've picked down here has tested stronger than the same herb picked on the surface. I don't know why, and nobody in the Codex believes me.

I need a fair test. Brew me some Elixirs of Arcane Fury, and use herbs you pick in this cavern yourself, not anything from my shelves. Arcane Fury is hard to get right. If it comes out at full strength from Underdark herbs, then it isn't me or my stock making the difference, it's something about this place.
kb_reagents.turn_in_text:
Every one of them came out at full strength, and this one is stronger than it should be. That's what I've been seeing for three years.

I'll take these up to the Codex-Master myself this time. Thank you.

kb_naturalist_funding.title: One Big Fungus
kb_naturalist_funding.description: Bring Naturalist Orienne Live Bloom Threads from the Mycelial Husks in the Mycelial Reach.
kb_naturalist_funding.accept_text:
I've asked the Codex to let me survey the fungus four times now, and they've said no every time. They have it written down as scenery.

I think every bit of fungus in this cavern is one living thing, growing under all of it, this town included. If I can show the threads from different places are the same organism, they'll have to listen.

The Mycelial Husks out in the Mycelial Reach, south-west of the gate, carry live threads. Bring me a good handful. If you can, take them from husks in different parts of the Reach.
kb_naturalist_funding.turn_in_text:
They're all the same organism, every one of them. This town is sitting on top of it.

I'll write it up for the Codex tonight. They'll probably make me write it twice. Thank you for getting these.

kb_enchanter_debt.title: Where the Power Comes From
kb_enchanter_debt.description: Bring Enchanter Vaelios Lattice Cores from the Shard Diviners in the Lattice, and thin the diviners out while you're there.
kb_enchanter_debt.accept_text:
The crystal down here gives off so much arcane power that I haven't had to use my own in two years. I don't know where it comes from, and that worries me.

The Shard Diviners in the Lattice draw on it the same way I do. I need a good few of them dead and some of their cores on my bench. I want to leave the cores on my bench overnight and see whether they keep drawing power when nobody's using them.

The Lattice is north-east of the gate, past the Sporefall.
kb_enchanter_debt.turn_in_text:
I left them on the bench all night and they kept drawing power the whole time. Whatever is putting it out isn't asking for anything back.

I'd still like to know what happens if it stops. Thank you for bringing these.

kb_sentinel_wager.title: The Cold Floor
kb_sentinel_wager.description: Bring Hall-Sentinel Durannis Dim Residues from the Dim-Walkers in the Dim Reaches.
kb_sentinel_wager.accept_text:
The floor of the Codex Hall was cut from stone we quarried in the Dim Reaches. For the last month it's been cold, and only along the lines where the stones were laid. The air in the hall is fine. It's the stone that's cold.

I want to know if it's still connected to where it came from. The Dim-Walkers out in the Dim Reaches leave a residue behind. Bring me some scrapings of it and I'll see if it does the same thing.

The Dim Reaches are the dark corner in the far south-west of the cavern. Take a light and go further in than the edge.
kb_sentinel_wager.turn_in_text:
I kept these in a jar in a warm room for three days and they went cold in the same pattern as the floor. So the stone is still connected to the Dim Reaches somehow.

I'll show the jar to the magisters. Thanks for going out there.

kb_the_question.title: The Codex-Master's Question
kb_the_question.description: Visit the Weeping Colonnade and bring Codex-Master Ilarien Worked Dalaran Fragments from the Archive Revenants.
kb_the_question.accept_text:
I'd like you to go and stand in the Weeping Colonnade. It's south of the gate, and it's full of Dalaran stonework that nobody brought down here. While you're there, bring me some worked fragments from the revenants.

When you come back I want to ask you something. You came to this world three years ago, and we came down here the same year, when this cavern first opened. I want to know whether the Colonnade feels to you like something we found, or something that was left here for whoever came first.
kb_the_question.turn_in_text:
You said it feels like both. That's what Scholar Veridan told me too, and it's what I think myself.

I still don't know how to write it down. Thank you for going, and for answering.

kb_sealed_entry.title: Your Entry in the Codex
kb_sealed_entry.description: Bring Codex-Master Ilarien Worked Dalaran Fragments, Druses With an Inclusion and Grown Leaves, and press Frostpine Pages.
kb_sealed_entry.accept_text:
Everyone in the Bastion has an entry in the Codex, and we keep adding to them. I've never closed one. I'd like to close yours, and seal it, because of what you've done down here.

Bring me something from each of the places you've been. Worked fragments from the revenants in the Weeping Colonnade, south of the gate. Druses from the Druse Crawlers in the Hollow Geode, east past the Lattice. Leaves from the Shelf-Grown in the Deep Bloom, whose door is in the Dim Reaches to the south-west.

And press some frostpine pages yourself for the entry. The Archive can't spare the paper.
kb_sealed_entry.turn_in_text:
It's written and sealed, and it can't be changed now. I've never been sure enough of anything down here to do that before.

Thank you for everything you've done for the Codex. You'll always be welcome here.
